title: MA-258 supplemental sensitivity: flattened-parameter Mirror orbit versus PSP expert bank
hypothesis: For eight aligned expert matrices generated along one orthogonal Mirror orbit, one shared matrix plus eight FP16 angles will preserve function quality within 0.01 normalized MSE of independent experts and use at most half the actual bytes of a rank-2 shared-basis control; for unrelated expert matrices, the same Mirror orbit code will miss the quality gate. Fixed-sign PSP is the mandatory direct unbinding control.
mirror_coordinate: one FP16 rotation angle per expert; rotate adjacent coordinates of the flattened matrix to construct each logical expert
logical_multiplicity: eight logical 16x16 experts reconstructed from one shared matrix plus eight view angles

model.aligned_regime: eight target matrices are pairwise orthogonal rotations of one random base matrix with seeded angles in [-0.7,0.7] radians
model.unrelated_regime: eight independent random target matrices scaled to the same mean Frobenius norm

controls: independent full expert matrices (upper quality reference)
hard tied expert equal to the bank mean
PA16 fixed random-sign parameter superposition: one summed tensor plus packed sign contexts
ordinary rank-2 SVD shared mean/basis with per-expert coefficients
one shared Mirror orbit matrix plus learned per-expert angles

evaluation.primary_metric: per-expert normalized Frobenius MSE and random-input output MSE after serialization reload
evaluation.interference_metric: task-specific reconstruction error for every expert
evaluation.storage: actual ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes including metadata, context codes, bases and headers
evaluation.compute: report optimizer updates/wall time for Mirror fitting and reconstruction operations per expert

development_gates_by_regime.aligned_success: Both seeds: Mirror maximum per-expert normalized MSE <=0.01 and Mirror actual bytes <=0.50x rank-2 SVD bytes.
development_gates_by_regime.unrelated_boundary: Report as family limitation if Mirror maximum per-expert normalized MSE >0.10 in either seed; do not tune on this regime.
development_gates_by_regime.fresh_policy: If aligned development gate passes, open all three fresh seeds with frozen settings. Unrelated results remain a preregistered boundary audit.

success_gate: All fresh aligned seeds meet MSE and actual-byte gates. Report unrelated regime separately; success is scoped only to aligned expert families.
failure_gate: Any fresh aligned seed misses the registered aligned quality or byte gate.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 payload after reload
paid_objects: one shared matrix or reconstruction basis

boundaries: oracle weight-bank compression on synthetic linear operators; not trained Transformer/MoE evidence
aligned data are intentionally generated from the Mirror orbit; this is a favorable mechanism test
rank-2 SVD is an ordinary shared-basis control and can recover any rank-2 matrix bank
legacy artifact/cache files already present in this untracked directory are excluded; this clean rerun uses only the newly listed seeds and results path
This is a protocol-distinct strict sensitivity rerun; it does not replace the canonical output-channel Givens screen or its PROMISING result.
